question.prompt: The sorted data are 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11, 12 (7 values in total). When the number of data values is odd, exclude the median itself, then take the medians of the lower 3 values and the upper 3 values to obtain the first and third quartiles. Find the interquartile range.

solutions.explanation: After excluding the median 7, the median of the lower half, 2, 4, 5, is 4, and the median of the upper half, 9, 11, 12, is 11. The interquartile range is \(11-4=7\).
solutions.title: Exclude the overall median
